name: One Aldwych
insider_take: This Edwardian masterpiece seamlessly blends contemporary luxury with timeless British elegance in the heart of Theatreland.
whats_special: One Aldwych is housed in a stunning 1907 Edwardian building that was once the headquarters of the Morning Post newspaper. The hotel features an incredible 18-meter chlorine-free swimming pool with underwater music - the only one of its kind in London. Art lovers will appreciate the rotating contemporary art collection throughout the property, including works by leading British artists.
pro_tip: Book the Charlie Chaplin Suite - the legendary actor actually lived in this very building when it housed newspaper offices, and the suite pays homage to his connection to the property.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you within a 2-minute walk of Covent Garden's world-class shopping and dining, while over 40 West End theaters are literally on your doorstep. The building's original Sicilian marble columns and mahogany paneling have been beautifully preserved, creating Instagram-worthy backdrops throughout your stay.
pros: Prime Covent Garden location with easy access to theaters and attractions
Exceptional contemporary art collection throughout the property
Award-winning Axis restaurant with innovative cuisine
Unique chlorine-free swimming pool with underwater music
cons: Busy central London location may experience street noise
